defect: Reusable administrator PAT was exposed to manual workflows that execute mutable repository code.

remediation.trigger: first push of this exact file to main
actions: read-only capture of the current credential fingerprint and unchanged policy; no deletion or revocation until a subsequent protected PR pins that exact receipt
verify disabled workflow states and unchanged full protection
attempt exact secret deletion with PAT, then existing short-lived workflow token if PAT is forbidden
if both deletions are forbidden, persist full-policy checkpoint and submit only this obsolete PAT to the unauthenticated GitHub issuer revocation endpoint
require issuer authentication rejection (HTTP 401), then read back workflow states and enforced protection summary
remove the one-shot through a protected cleanup PR and retain exact receipts
remediation.recovery: Absent secret: original credentialless read-only recovery. Invalidated PAT: require GitHub /user HTTP 401 and read-only disabled-workflow/protection-summary checks. Revocation queue acceptance alone never suffices; preserve the pre-revocation full-policy checkpoint.

first_attempt.failure_message: Resource not accessible by personal access token

acceptance_rule: Secret deletion confirmed, or issuer revocation accepted (202) and exact credential authentication rejected (401), with any undeletable encrypted metadata explicitly recorded; unchanged full policy checkpoint, independent live readbacks, complete validation/review, and protected one-shot cleanup are required.
identity_rule: The empty workflow fingerprint permits only read-only capture. A separate protected activation PR must bind its fingerprint to the captured current repository credential; any replacement fails before any API call. No claim that an unobserved historical credential has this identity is made.
